knowledge_graph.title: Etiwanda High School
knowledge_graph.type: Public school in Rancho Cucamonga, California
knowledge_graph.description: Etiwanda High School is a public high school in Rancho Cucamonga, California, United States. It is one of the twelve schools of the Chaffey Joint Union High School District and serves students in the Etiwanda community on the northeast side of Rancho Cucamonga.
